decisionsTitle: The club's discretion over places, in neutral words: a public repository's wording
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02 evening:** «Always keep in mind that the code is public and we care about our reputation». The rules about handing a place to a named person from the waiting list are written for everyone to read, so they must be true and describe no identifiable person.

This branch edits the wording of landed sections §615, §620, §627, §629, §634, §637, §640, §642 — the one exception to a branch never writing DECISIONS.md — because the wording is the task; no rule, number, date or reference moved.

**What was reworded (words only).** In §615, §634, §637, §640 and §642, and in §629's rule sentence: the sentences that described one registrant (a form's exact time, the outage's delay, a description of the person as a club member, quotes that identified a case) now describe the case: a registration stuck at the first step after a form sent during the launch, or a person the organizers name, such as an invited runner, an organizer who runs, a pacemaker, a partner or a registration the email outage disrupted. «The people he chooses» and «the club chooses the person» became the organizers naming a person. §618's grounds concern refusing or cancelling a registration and are not cited for an offer; the terms' template now states the offer's own grounds (below). §615's «three points» paragraph again says only what was relayed with it; §642 says a registration the email outage had disrupted was on the waiting list; §634's first quote is indirect speech stating the product decision — the waiting list and anyone's position on it are not shown publicly by default — and its second quote stands as it was; §637's «ASAP» reference no longer points at a removed quote. The same wording reaches the code comments and the test header that quoted the case (give-place-now test, `registrations/service.ts`, `db/schema/events.ts`, `audit/repository.ts`), and the «Ghid» step «Nu acceptă la timp?» says, in the guide's own second person, «Oferta expiră și locul e din nou liber, până îl dai tu.» / «The offer lapses and the place is free again until you give it.»; the changelog bullet of §615 says an organizer sends the offer to a named person.

**What did not change.** Every rule, number, section reference, date, identifier and key; the verbs «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Dă-i un loc acum» and «În afara locurilor» and who may press them; the participant-facing sentence «Clubul alege cui oferă un loc eliberat.»; the owner's quotes that state a product decision. Git history and earlier PR descriptions keep the old words.

**The quotes that described a choice of persons, replaced by their reason.** §620's English quote about picking people from the waiting list is now indirect speech: the organizers must be able to offer a waiting-list place to a named person while automatic offers are off; its title and its list say «the offers by the organizers». §615 keeps the configuration quote and drops the two that followed it: the three-points paragraph already says the race has 200 medals and announces 150 places, a margin the club keeps on purpose. In §627 and §629 the quote about the people waiting not learning when the rest registered gives way to the rule and, in the decision's own voice, its reason: §629 says «He narrowed the first: no position while automatic offers are off. A position would promise an order the club does not follow then.», and §627 says the same in two sentences, so the reason is never put in the owner's mouth. `docs/QUEUE.md`'s row for `feat/waiting-list-position-for-each` gives the same reason in place of the quote. §627's «hand-picked order» became «the order the forms were sent», and the comment of `listQueueForEvent` (`registrations/admin-repository.ts`) says «a line the organizers hand out by the form's time». The rule is word for word what it was — no position while automatic offers are off, the form's time a backoffice line and never public — and the comment of `registrations/ui/waitlist-position-words.ts` says the same.

**One word for the person offered a place.** «Chosen» became «named» throughout — `SETUP.md` §39, `AGENTS.md` (two phrases, wording only), `docs/QUEUE.md`'s row for `BR-V2.55`, the guide's step («persoanei numite» / «named person's»), the comments of `registrations/service.ts` and `audit/repository.ts`, and the titles of `offer-any-time.test.ts`. The comments and test titles that called the one registrant of §637 «she» or «her» (`hold-deadlines.ts`, `registrations/service.ts`, the registration's page, `give-place-now.test.ts`) say «the person», «the row» or «the registration». No key, rule or behaviour moved.

**The terms' template describes what the product does, in both modes (amending the template of §418).** Its waiting-list paragraph promised «în ordinea confirmării» / «in order of confirmation» while an event with automatic offers off lets the organizers name the person offered a freed place (§615, §642), and the club may seat people outside the advertised places (§643). The paragraph now says, in both languages: with no place left you join the waiting list; if the event offers freed places automatically they go in order of confirmation, the first on the list having `{{offerHours}}` to sign before the offer passes on; otherwise the organizers offer each freed place to one person on the list, on objective grounds they can state — the order on the list, an invited runner, an organizer who runs, a pacemaker, for example — with the same deadline; and apart from the advertised places the club may seat organizers, volunteers, pacemakers, partners and invited runners («sportivi invitați») outside them, who take none of the advertised places. The owner's rule: clean, fair and configurable, and the participant told. The terms in force on production keep their words until an Administrator approves terms from the new template (`/admin/legal`, «Versiune nouă» → «Pornește de la șablon»), which `CLAUDE.md`'s «Still owed» item 16 now says; §639's email tells the Administrators the template moved.

**The privacy notice's template says the same (amending the template of §418).** Its paragraph on the registration's history said the platform manages places and the waiting list automatically, «după o singură regulă pentru toți» / «by one rule for all», and grounded the art. 22 GDPR sentence on it — false for an event with automatic offers off and for «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc acum» and «În afara locurilor», and in contradiction with the terms' new paragraph; the club approves both in the same sitting. The paragraph keeps its first sentence (the history and its legal basis), its two placeholders `{{holdMinutes}}` and `{{offerHours}}` and its place, and now says: the platform manages places and the waiting list by the rules in the terms — in order of confirmation where the event offers freed places automatically, otherwise an organizer names the person offered the place on objective grounds and the platform records who and when; some places are given outside the advertised ones (organizers, volunteers, pacemakers, partners, invited runners) and take none of them; a place held and not signed for in time passes to the next on the waiting list, automatically where the event offers automatically, otherwise through an organizer; no profiling; the automatic step applies the same rule to everyone and is not considered a decision under art. 22 GDPR, while a place given by an organizer is a human's decision; and anyone may ask a person on the team to review what happened to their place. The notice in force keeps its words until an Administrator approves a notice from the new template; `CLAUDE.md`'s «Still owed» item 16 names both texts.

**For counsel.** The two templates describe the two modes and the places outside the advertised ones. They do not describe two cases the product also allows: with automatic offers on, an Administrator may still add one supplementary place for a named person on the waiting list (§642); and «Dă-i un loc acum» seats a registration whose address was never confirmed and which is not on the waiting list at all (§637). Counsel decides whether either needs a sentence.
changelogLine: **The documents describe the club's discretion over places in neutral words, and the terms' and the privacy notice's templates describe both modes of the waiting list** — the decisions, the guide and the code comments say an organizer offers a place to a named person and no longer describe an individual registrant; the terms' template now says freed places go in order of confirmation when the event offers them automatically, otherwise to one person the organizers name on objective grounds, and that the club may seat organizers, volunteers, pacemakers, partners and invited runners outside the advertised places; the privacy notice's template says the same in place of «one rule for all», and that a place given by an organizer is a human's decision — both to be approved in «Texte legale» like every text. §NNN.
